retrievalProfile.description: A sophisticated, painterly layout featuring a central square musical illustration framed by wide cream margins and elegant, spaced-out serif text.
triggerTerms: framed square artwork with wide margins
excludeWhen: bold sans-serif or street-art styles are requested
high-contrast neon color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central square oil-painting style illustration of an acoustic guitar and double bass, characterized by warm amber highlights and deep mahogany shadows, set against a textured cream background with wide borders and centered classical serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Central square artwork nested within a larger rectangular cream field
Warm wood tones of instruments contrasting with the neutral cream background
Text positioned symmetrically above and below the central image
Soft, directional lighting on the hand and guitar body creating depth
coreInvariants: Wide, uniform cream-colored margins surrounding the central image
Painterly, non-photographic texture within the central square
Small-caps or widely tracked serif typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musical instruments are contained within a central square that occupies approximately 60% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The hand resting on the acoustic guitar serves as the primary focal point due to its high value contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, moves down to the hand, follows the diagonal of the guitar neck, and rests on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the form of a thick cream border provides a sense of luxury and focus.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation background with high value contrast within the central illustration.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic serif pairing using scale and tracking for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical Roman proportions and elegant serifs.
Provides the necessary sophisticated, timeless feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured cream background with a central square oil painting of an acoustic guitar and double bass in warm earth tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered, widely-spaced serif text in dark brown at the top and bottom margins.

verificationChecks: Is the central image a square?
Is the text centered and widely tracked?
Is the color palette limited to warm earth tones and cream?
Does the illustration have a painterly texture?

mustRedesign: Any photographic elements into painterly illustrations
Any modern sans-serif fonts into classical serifs
Any cluttered layouts into the framed square format
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is not touching the central image
Verify the 'oil paint' brushstrokes are visible
Check that the cream background has a subtle paper-like texture
Confirm the instruments are the primary subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Central square painterly illustration + wide cream margins + centered widely-spaced serif text = Sophisticated Jazz Aesthetic.
